output.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_completed_order FROM marts.fct_orders o WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Averages item_count over completed orders (is_revenue = true, i.e. status = 'completed') with order_date in calendar year 2025, since fiscal year equals calendar year. Rounded to 2 decimals. Uses only fct_orders, which has no restricted columns.
